lines.t: Verse 1:
“Walking through the fire, but I’m not alone,
God’s light is shining, guiding me home.
Every storm I face, He gives me the strength,
Turning every trial into victory at length.
Feet on the rock, my foundation is sure,
Through every battle, His love will endure.”
Chorus:
“With faith in my heart, I rise above,
Victorious through the power of His love.
No fear, no doubt, I stand and say,
By His hand, I overcome today.
Through every storm, I walk His way,
By His hand, I overcome today.”
Verse 2:
“Chains fall away, the enemy can’t win,
Through every battle, God’s voice calls me in.
Armor on my soul, I walk unshaken,
Every step I take, His glory’s awakened.
Prayer in my chest, sword of the Spirit in hand,
I fight with His truth, I will firmly stand.”
Bridge 1:
“Through valleys low, through mountains high,
I trust the Lord, His truth is my guide.
Every fear fades, every shadow departs,
‘Cause He lights the path and strengthens my heart.”
Verse 3:
“Storms may roar, but my hope won’t fade,
YahuShua has conquered, His power displayed.
Every trial a lesson, every pain refined,
I rise in His love, leaving doubt behind.
Victory’s mine, not by my might,
But through the Savior who brings the light.”
Mini-Chorus:
“Stand tall, walk strong, in His name I fight,
Through the darkest hour, He is my light.
No chain can bind me, no fear can stay,
By His hand, I rise, I overcome today.”
Verse 4:
“Every battle faced, every tear I’ve cried,
He’s been my rock, always by my side.
Faith is my armor, prayer is my shield,
Through Him alone, every wound is healed.
Marching forward, I’ll never retreat,
With God as my guide, I cannot be beat.”
“Lift up your hands, let the praises roar,
Victory in YahuShua forevermore.
The world may shake, the night may fall,
But His power reigns above it all.”
“With faith in my heart, I rise above,
Victorious through the power of His love.
No fear, no doubt, I stand and say,
By His hand, I overcome today.
Through every storm, I walk His way,
By His hand, I overcome today.
Hands lifted high, let the world hear my praise,
I walk in His victory all of my days.”
